Recommend a shared **in-place result-entry animation**, triggered by the committed reporting period. Keep the selector mounted and animate one existing content container with Web Animations. This avoids Svelte keyed remounts, outgoing duplicate DOM, focus loss inside controls, and blank loading intervals. Current flow: `PeriodSelector.svelte` builds native link URLs from `$app/state.page`, preserving context and deleting `from`, `to`, and `page`. Server loads own selected data; summaries receive committed periods. Slow same-path navigation already keeps old content and selection visible with `aria-busy`, and tests require unchanged scroll. Consumers are exactly `MemberSummary.svelte`, `FunderSummary.svelte`, and `routes/rankings/+page.svelte`. Suggested usage: ```svelte
``` ```svelte
...
 ``` `ContentChange` is a UI presentation component: ```ts type Props = { changeKey: string; children: Snippet; class?: ClassValue; // additive root hook only, if needed }; ``` It owns only one root element, its animation handle, and the last committed key. Initial render produces normal SSR content with no motion. On a changed key, cancel the previous animation and animate the same element from modest opacity/vertical offset to its normal state over roughly 180ms. Never interpolate money, height, or widths. Skip animation under reduced motion; cancel an active animation if that preference changes. No `role`, `aria-live`, hidden clone, loading state, or API knowledge belongs here. For placement, add a native flex wrapper around the selector inside `PeriodSelector.svelte`, using `justify-content: flex-end`. This consistently right-aligns its links across all consumers while retaining wrapping at 320px. Do not change all `ViewLinks variant="filter"` globally: its generic contract does not require right alignment. Member and funder filters stay below tabs, inside Summary. Rankings should place the selector in its own full-width row beneath the heading/wheel row so “right” means the page content’s right edge rather than the heading column’s edge. Files: - `frontend/src/PeriodSelector.svelte`: right-aligned presentation wrapper; retain native links and reset behavior. - `frontend/src/lib/ui/ContentChange.svelte`, `index.ts`, `README.md`, `COMPOSITION.md`: reusable animation contract and export. - `frontend/src/routes/design-system/+page.svelte`: interactive gallery example with a state change and existing controls. - `MemberSummary.svelte`, `FunderSummary.svelte`, `routes/rankings/+page.svelte`: animate only affected results. - `frontend/tests/periods.spec.ts`, `design-system.spec.ts`: acceptance coverage. Alternative rejected: keyed `{#key period}` with enter/exit transitions. It remounts child components and can temporarily leave two copies of chart/table/heading IDs accessible; entry-only keyed transitions still reset disclosures and focused descendants. A browser View Transition is heavier, introduces navigation timing policy, and needs snapshot handling for exact financial content. Acceptance: desktop selector’s right edge matches its Summary/content container; it remains below tabs and outside identity on mobile and desktop; all three consumers animate after committed period changes; initial SSR and reduced-motion rendering have no animation; delayed navigation preserves previous content, selection, and scroll; one result subtree exists throughout; rapid changes cancel prior motion; error responses remove previous financial data as existing tests require. Retain exact huge decimals, null/zero behavior, URL context, history independence, keyboard link behavior, and existing loading tests. Run check/build, affected Playwright tests, and capture desktop PR screenshots.
